verdict.rationale: Pipedream is documented as an 'App marketplace' with 3,000+ APIs/10,000+ tools, each app having its own dedicated MCP server and per-app docs (e.g. clickup.md) listing available tools, which supports browsing by app/capability. However there's no explicit evidence of a dedicated search-by-capability interface or catalog UI beyond app-level docs pages. missing for 10: explicit search/filter UI evidence, independent hands-on confirmation of browsing workflow.
